definitions.explanation: The length of time someone has lived.

examples.japanese: {年齢|ねんれい}を{教|おし}えてください。
{年齢|ねんれい}{制限|せいげん}があります。
{年齢|ねんれい}に{関係|かんけい}なく{参加|さんか}できる。
examples.english: You can participate regardless of age.

notes:
{年齢|ねんれい} is a formal word for age.

FORMALITY:
More formal than {歳|とし} or お{年|とし}. Used in official documents, forms, and formal discussions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {年齢|ねんれい}を{聞|き}く: to ask someone's age
- {年齢|ねんれい}{制限|せいげん}: age restriction/limit
- {年齢|ねんれい}{層|そう}: age group/demographic
- {年齢|ねんれい}{順|じゅん}: in order of age

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {年齢|ねんれい}に{関係|かんけい}なく: regardless of age
- {年齢|ねんれい}を{重|かさ}ねる: to grow older (literary)
- {年齢|ねんれい}{相応|そうおう}: age-appropriate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {歳|とし}/{年|とし}: age (casual)
- お{歳|とし}: age (polite when asking)
- {年齢|ねんれい}: age (formal)
